import numpy as np, math
ND,NW,NT=3000,24,600
Ds=np.linspace(2.0,2.3,ND)
ts=np.concatenate([[0.0],np.geomspace(0.2,20.0,NT-1)])
lnlam=np.fromfile('results/window2023_lnlam.bin').reshape(ND,NW,NT)
d=np.load('results/window2023_lnlam_theta.npz'); eps,TH=d['eps'],d['TH'].astype(float)
bnd=np.array([eps[np.where(TH[:,i]>=1)[0][-1]] if TH[0,i]>=1 else np.nan for i in range(ND)])
print("argmax direction omega* along the exclusion boundary:")
prev=None
for i in range(0,ND,75):
    e=bnd[i]
    vals=np.min(lnlam[i]-ts*e,axis=1)     # per-omega Legendre value
    w=int(np.argmax(vals))
    gap=np.sort(vals)[-1]-np.sort(vals)[-2]
    mark=" <-- SWITCH" if prev is not None and w!=prev else ""
    print(f"  D={Ds[i]:.3f} eps*={e:.4f}: omega* = {w} (2pi*{w}/24), runner-up gap {gap:.5f}{mark}")
    prev=w
PY
